id./param/scenario/cs/a_180_cs_040.pack|cs_: "How beautiful... What do these pictures depict?
"These paintings illustrate a passage from the myths of Arboria.
"The Luminary is a soul chosen by Yggdrasil, born whenever disaster threatens the world...
"The first Luminary descended upon this world long, long ago, in the Age of Heroes.
"All life in Erdrea springs from Yggdrasil. The god of evil sought to steal the Heart of the Tree, the very root of life.
"Born to meet that age was Erdwin, the Luminary of Legend, who bore the same mark as you, {var:1}.
"And fighting at his side was a sage named Serenica...
"Serenica is said to be reborn as your companions Veronica and Serena.
"I wondered why you were born a Luminary in an age without the Dark One. Your tale makes it all clear."
